nodes.title: Slice class IsSlice: h in C¹[0,∞) with h = O(r⁻³) as r → ∞
nodes.source_hypotheses: h is one fixed-u radial slice, a continuous real function of r on [0,∞) ( /; the source writes the u = 0 slice h(0,r))

nodes.title: A C¹ function on a compact interval is Lipschitz there
nodes.source_hypotheses: f is C¹ on [a,b] (one-sided derivatives at the endpoints, derivative continuous on [a,b])
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all a ≤ b, for all such f, there exists L ≥ 0 such that for all s, t in [a,b]
nodes.source_conclusion: abs(f(s) − f(t)) ≤ L·abs(s − t) (extreme value theorem plus mean value inequality)
nodes.constant_scope: L depends only on f and [a,b]
